description: Look up routed volume, the Ophis base fee, and the integrator's own fee on CoW-hosted chains, by appCode (your widget appCode or SDK ophisReferrer code). Routed volume is reported in USD, split by chain and by Ophis-operated versus CoW-hosted chains. Read-only, keyless, cumulative.

appCode.description: Your integrator appCode / referral code (3-64 chars of [a-z0-9_-]).

name: get_integrator_earnings
